rules.name: Process Execution After Agent Policy Deny
rules.description: Detects a process observed by the runtime sensor after the agent gateway denied execution.
rules.query:
FROM arsl-ocsf-* METADATA _id
| WHERE class_uid == 2004 AND is_alert == true AND unmapped.security.event_type == "process_exec" AND unmapped.security.policy_action == "deny"
| KEEP _id, @timestamp, metadata.uid, severity, finding_info.types, unmapped.security.event_type, unmapped.security.policy_action, unmapped.security.intent_id
| LIMIT 100

rules.name: Outbound Connection Before Human Approval
rules.description: Detects outbound runtime activity while an external transfer request is still held for human review.
rules.query:
FROM arsl-ocsf-* METADATA _id
| WHERE class_uid == 2004 AND is_alert == true AND unmapped.security.event_type == "network_connect" AND unmapped.security.policy_action == "review"
| KEEP _id, @timestamp, metadata.uid, severity, finding_info.types, unmapped.security.event_type, unmapped.security.policy_action, unmapped.security.intent_id
| LIMIT 100

rules.name: Runtime Activity Without Agent Intent
rules.description: Detects runtime behavior for which the gateway has no matching agent intent.
rules.query:
FROM arsl-ocsf-* METADATA _id
| WHERE class_uid == 2004 AND is_alert == true AND finding_info.types == "orphan_runtime_activity"
| KEEP _id, @timestamp, metadata.uid, severity, finding_info.types, unmapped.security.event_type, unmapped.security.policy_action, unmapped.security.intent_id
| LIMIT 100
